description_en: Invoke GetQualityProjectList to obtain the quality inspection job list.
description_zh: 调用GetQualityProjectList获取质检任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs get-quality-project-list --instance-id ccc_xp_pre000 --project-id 15 --project-name '质检' --status 0 --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --check-freq-type 1 --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetQualityProjectList

parameters.help_en: Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID. You can obtain it from the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console.
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。可在智能联络中心控制台上获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Quality inspection job ID (supports fuzzy search).
parameters.help_zh: 质检任务ID（支持模糊搜索）
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: Quality inspection job name (supports fuzzy search).
parameters.help_zh: 质检任务名（支持模糊搜索）
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en:
Quality inspection job status. Valid values:  

0: Start  
1: Shutdown
parameters.help_zh:
质检任务状态。取值：

0：启动
1：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The check frequency type. Valid values:

1: Periodic quality inspection
4: Temporary quality inspection
parameters.help_zh:
检查频次类型。取值：

1：周期质检
4：临时质检
parameters.name: check_freq_type
